title: Some battles won’t move… until you kneel.
paragraphs:
Some battles won’t move… until you kneel.
Prayer isn’t the last option — it’s the first weapon.
“The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.” — James 5:16 (NIV)

When life hits hardest, the enemy hopes you stay silent.
But heaven waits for your voice.
You lose battles you refuse to fight —
and prayer is how you fight back.
Kneel now… rise victorious later. ✨🙏
